core_obligations: Set d = dim Lambda_q and R = k[x_1, ..., x_d]; construct B = A[x_1, ..., x_d, z_{ij}]/(x_i^n - sum z_{ij} a_j) from generators a_j of H_{A/R}; the opens B_{a_j} and B_{x_i} are smooth over R.
Apply the improve-presentation lemma to get B -> C with retraction, and the compare-standard lemma to get c > 0 with x_i^c strictly standard in C over R.
The find-sequence lemma produces pi_1, ..., pi_d in Lambda with pi_i^n in h_A and the annihilator equalities; define B -> Lambda by x_i -> pi_i, z_{ij} -> lambda_ij.
Apply the lift-solution lemma with the sequence x_1^c, ..., x_d^c: it suffices to resolve the quotient situation modulo x_i^e, pi_i^e for e = 8c.

The delocalize-height-zero lemma reduces to the localization at q; there R_p -> Lambda_q/(pi^e) is a flat map of Artinian local rings with separable residue field extension, hence a filtered colimit of smooth algebras by the colimit-syntomic lemma and the deformation proposition.
The when-colimit lemma extracts the desired solution.
proof_roadmap: Auxiliary algebra construction; standardization; parameter sequence; quotient reduction; localization to Artinian; colimit recognition.
